why: No earlier contest for this seat is among the past results held here.
g: Oklahoma prints a race on the November ballot only when it is contested (the Clerk of the House's statistics: 'According to Oklahoma law, the names of those with no opposition are not printed on the ballot'), so a candidate unopposed at filing, or elected outright in the June primary or the August runoff, has no November result here.
City, town and school board elections held at other times

Most Oklahoma city, town and school board elections are held in the spring, not in November; only the city, town, school and fire district contests and questions that were on this November ballot are here.
The State Election Board's certified summary of November 2024

The Board's archive lists an agenda and minutes for its certification meeting of 12 November 2024 but no meeting packet, and both are scans, so no certified summary of the 2024 figures can be read. The federal contests are compared with the Clerk of the House's statistics; every other 2024 contest rests on the Board's own precinct and county results files agreeing with each other, and carries no separate certified total.
